reported.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the armed lamp
reported.description: The loop reads D6 and calls toggleArmed() on every HIGH->LOW transition with no 50 ms settle window (lines 52-58), so each contact bounce is treated as a separate press. Measured evidence shows 4 toggles per press in the bounce scenario ([4, 4, 4, 4]) and 3 per press in the rapid-press scenario ([3, 3, 3, 3, ...]), far exceeding the required exactly-one toggle. Release chatter also produces spurious HIGH->LOW edges, causing 12 and 10 unexplained toggles (first at 1.40 s and 2.00 s), violating 'release must not toggle'. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D9 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D9 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Shop estop pushbutton on D6 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); machine-armed indicator on D9.
- Each settled press toggles D9 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce bursts up to 22 ms must not produce more than one toggle per physical press.
- Use a 50 ms settle window before accepting a press.
- Print `shop armed=<0|1> presses=<n>` every 1200 ms.
- Unpressed idle level is HIGH on D6.
